findings.evidence: `grep -n "NatIso\|scalarExtensionFunctor\|Tannaka\|CategoryTheory\|toModuleIso" Representation/SemisimplePoint.lean` returns nothing; ScalarExtension.lean declares no instances (only defs/theorems), and its own imports are `Representation.PointsAction` and `Coalgebra.Comodule.Finite.ScalarExtension.Basic` (→ `Comodule/Finite/Basic.lean`, where `FGComoduleCat`'s instances live at lines 96-111, 312).
findings.fix: Replace it with the modules that actually supply the used names: `TauCeti.Algebra.AlgebraicGroup.Representation.PointsAction` (`Comodule.pointsAction`, `pointsAction_toLinearMap`) and `TauCeti.Algebra.Coalgebra.Comodule.Finite.Basic` (`FGComoduleCat` and its `AddCommGroup`/`Module`/`Comodule`/`Module.Finite` instances).
findings.issue: `public import TauCeti.Algebra.AlgebraicGroup.Representation.ScalarExtension` is unused: no declaration of that module (`pointNatIso`, `pointNatIsoHom`, `fgPointNatIsoHom`, `scalarExtensionFunctor`, …) and no `CategoryTheory` name appears anywhere in this file; it only serves as a transitive route to `Comodule.pointsAction` and `FGComoduleCat`, while pulling the Tannakian functor stack into every consumer of `IsSemisimplePoint`.

summary: Placement is now correct: the adjoin lemma sits in RingTheory/Adjoin/, the GL coercion lemmas are gone (now Mathlib's), and the general semisimple-point API is out of Tannaka/. The remaining issue is that the general file still imports the Tannakian scalar-extension functor module it never uses, so consumers of the predicate still drag in the categorical stack the split was meant to avoid.
